class.name: kontrolem_gz/GzBaseStateSystem
class.description: gz_ros2_control hardware component that exports a floating base's ground-truth world pose + body-frame twist (read directly from Gazebo's ECM) as the 13 floating_base scalar state interfaces, plus constant all-stance per-foot contact scalars — so the in-gz controller_manager can feed non-joint base/contact state to a whole-body controller alongside IgnitionSystem's joints.
